layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 minimum) to prevent text collision.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Mobile-First. Headings center-aligned only if required for balance. Lists, forms, dense content MUST be left-aligned.

components.cards: Subtle roundness (max 8px border-radius / rounded-lg). 1px solid border (#E5E7EB), flat background. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
components.buttons: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md). High contrast text. Hover: distinct lighter hue of active state color.
components.inputs: Shadcn Input heavily customized. Focus state: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-300 focus:border-blue-500.
components.tables: Shadcn DataTable. Dense spacing, clear column headers, hover state on rows (bg-gray-50). F-pattern visual hierarchy.
components.modals: Use glassmorphism overlay (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm) with flat solid white surface for the modal content.

image_urls.description: Abstract glass architecture for Auth pages split-screen background.
Professional corporate headshot portrait for B2B/Admin Profile.
Placeholder for analytics graphs in empty states.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Enter animations staggered for list items.

accessibility.contrast: APCA standard or WCAG AA (4.5:1). Never use gray-on-gray for text.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-form-submit-button').
accessibility.focus_management: Visible focus rings required on all form controls.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the Next.js 14+ App Router frontend using .js (JSX) extensions. Do not use .tsx files.
Implement the triple Auth system (Admin, B2B, B2C), using Next.js route groups (e.g., (auth), (dashboard)).
Develop Users Management (CRUD) and Roles Management (RBAC Permission Tree).
Dashboard must follow the 'F-pattern' layout hierarchy, reserving the top-left for the North Star Metric (e.g., headcount, retention).
Ensure the layout relies on Shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS with the styling overridden to match this JSON's 'Swiss & High-Contrast' archetype.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' or similar Display/Sans-Serif for authority. Use 'Inter' strictly for body text.
Always set explicit text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-gray-900 hover:text-white).
Load images strictly from the provided 'media' object URLs. No standard placeholder services.
